Answer: I learned about Hashed Indexing and Chaining. The idea is that hashes can be created out of values/objects and that hash can be utilized to insert and search an array in a particular way that makes finding objects easier. However, hash collisions can occur which is where chaining comes into play. Chaining utilizes linked lists and hashed indexing in order to account for instances where hash collisions occur by storing objects with the same hashes within the same linked list.
